stdout_tail: committed-tree export base is on a filesystem that shims extended attributes into AppleDouble ._* sidecar files: /Volumes/USBNVME16TB/temp_agent_space/tmp/ee-guard-arm-exfat. rch's dependency-closure preflight requires every globbed source entrypoint on the worker while .rchignore excludes ._* from the transfer, so every dispatch from this base is refused with [RCH-E410] missing source_entrypoint on every worker. Point RCH_VERIFY_COMMITTED_TREE_BASE at an xattr-native path -- on this host a sparse APFS image, created and attached per the recipe in CLAUDE.md -- and re-run. If that image is configured already, it is not currently attached.
